head: codex/5895-retire-csdlc-migrate-installer
title: [Backlog][C-SDLC v2] Prove retired csdlc-migrate is absent
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5895

Proves the retired `csdlc-migrate` entrypoint is absent from current installer, coexistence, proof, workflow, and every manifest-declared operator skill authority. Adds a real freshly built installed-generation canary that verifies exact Git provenance and coexistence before exercising claim-free create, validate, doctor, resolve, and bind.

Validation:
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate10a` (18 passed)
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate2` (1 passed)
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `git diff --check`

Independent exact-revision review approved after both findings were fixed. Split-authority doctor diagnostic is separately tracked as agent-logic/agent-design-language#45.
